15:t_1:3.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...From this day on, I, the ruler of $$サイデリアル$$, shall rule over your feeble kind.」

15:t_1:4.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Worship me, Earthlings! Worship the $$新地球皇国$$... and the $$サイデリアル$$!」

16:t_000:0.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「It's no use! They outnumber us too badly!」

16:t_001:0.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「We can't hold on! Please give the order to fall back!」

16:t_001:1.en:
$$アンドレイ$$
「Don't give up! If we pull back, who'll protect the citizens!?」

16:t_001:3.en:
$$アンドレイ$$
「Damn it! At this rate, Earth will...!」

21:t_1:3.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「...As already announced, this city is now under the control of the 《$$新地球皇国$$》!」

21:t_1:4.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Residents, follow your guides and move in a single line! You will now be tested on whether you are worthy of being Imperial subjects!」

21:t_1:5.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Those who pass will be accepted as subjects and receive the mercy of His Majesty the Emperor!」

21:t_1:6.en:
$$市民$$
「A test...? What are they going to make us do...」

21:t_1:7.en:
$$市民$$
「But if we pass it, we can become people of the Empire. Then at least our lives will be...」

21:t_1:8.en:
$$市民$$
「Shut up. Do you want to be their dog that badly?」

21:t_1:9.en:
$$市民$$
「It's so we can survive...! We have no choice, damn it!」

21:t_1:10.en:
$$市民$$
「Are you stupid? Do you know what happens to the people who pass?」

21:t_1:11.en:
$$市民$$
「I heard they're taken to the Empire's capital, 《$$ラース・バビロン$$》, and live there as subjects...」

21:t_1:12.en:
$$市民$$
「I wonder about that... Rumor has it that nobody can ever get in touch with the people who were sent there.」

21:t_1:15.en:
$$市民$$
「Who knows. ...But they say that if you don't pass, you get sent somewhere for hellish forced labor.」

21:t_1:16.en:
$$市民$$
「In short, our fate was sealed the moment those guys showed up.」

21:t_1:19.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「You are an inferior Earth race! Consider yourselves fortunate just to be given the chance to become Imperial subjects!」

21:t_1:20.en:
$$市民$$
「Inferior...? How much better are a bunch who invade Earth on their own and do whatever they want...!」

21:t_1:21.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「That defiant attitude...! You no longer qualify as an Imperial subject!」

21:t_1:22.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Therefore, you will be executed here!」

21:t_1:25.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Who are you!? Are you going to get in our way!?」

21:t_1:26.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I can't overlook any more of this lawlessness!」

21:t_1:27.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Lawlessness? His Majesty the Emperor himself is the law of this planet!」

21:t_1:28.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Therefore, the actions of us, his loyal soldiers, are...」

21:t_1:31.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Y-you dare to defy us too...!?」

21:t_1:34.en:
$n
「...Don't think you can do whatever you want forever, $$サイデリアル$$...」

21:t_1:36.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$... Did you forget about our infiltration mission?」

21:t_1:38.en:
$n
「You don't have to apologize. I'd reached my limit too.」

21:t_1:39.en:
$n
「Besides, I think the time is just about right.」

21:t_1:41.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Shh...! Please don't make a fuss right now.」

21:t_1:42.en:
$n
「Help will be here soon. Please let the townspeople know, without letting the Empire's goons find out.」

21:t_1:45.en:
$n
「We're the $$地球連邦軍$$ External Independent Unit, $c... We came here to rescue you.」

21:t_2:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

21:t_2:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「Captain... If you had business with us, we would have come to you.」

21:t_2:8.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That's all right. With the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ out gathering intelligence, I'm the $$マクロス・クォーター$$'s operations staff officer for now.」

21:t_2:9.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Also, there was something I wanted to tell everyone in the mobile force.」

21:t_2:10.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Did you find out something about those $$サイデリアル$$ guys...!?」

21:t_2:13.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「They apparently were set up all over the place at the same time the $$新地球皇国$$ was founded, but...」

21:t_2:14.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It is presumed to be some kind of energy flow produced by extraterrestrial technology.」

21:t_2:15.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Some of you may already know this, but it has also been confirmed that touching it replenishes a unit's energy.」

21:t_2:16.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I thought it was a system like sending power by microwave, but it must be something different.」

21:t_2:17.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...It's not certain yet, but we think it may be a line that 《$$次元力$$》 flows through.」

21:t_2:19.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Where are the $$サイデリアル$$ getting it from...?」

21:t_2:21.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... The $$サイデリアル$$ are most likely extracting $$地球の次元力$$ along the Earth's veins.」

21:t_2:22.en:
$$アルト$$
「So it's a system like 《$$インサラウム$$》's 《$$ＺＯＮＥ$$》...」

21:t_2:24.en:
$$アルト$$
「...$$インサラウム$$'s $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ ran out of control and drew out too much $$次元力$$, and the planet itself died...」

21:t_2:25.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That case shows that if the leylines are left alone, we may someday end up in the same situation as $$インサラウム$$.」

21:t_2:27.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Wait...! If that happened, even the $$新地球皇国$$ wouldn't come out of it unharmed...!」

21:t_2:28.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「This isn't their home planet...」

21:t_2:29.en:
$$甲児$$
「What do you mean, $$カミーユ$$?」
